title: Democrats in Maine formally nominate Troy Jackson as their new candidate for U.S. Senate
script: A new headline is now getting attention across the news cycle. Reports are focusing on this development: Democrats in Maine formally nominate Troy Jackson as their new candidate for U.S. Senate. In simple words, Democrats are hoping to move past Graham Platner's scandal-plagued campaign as they look to unseat Susan Collins.
